binaryBuildProtocol.toolchainIdentity: The manifest environment swiftVersion, xcodeVersion, xcodeBuild, sdkVersion, and architecture apply to both binaries.

blockedScenarios.reason: This deterministic cache retains syntax facts only; no embedding provider is initialized, so re-embedding counts remain unavailable.
SQVectorStatic is pin-consumable, but the SwiftDebt adapter is unmerged and no frozen exact-index benchmark scenario or raw release evidence exists.
No ANN implementation is available; exact local retrieval cannot establish approximate recall or ANN latency.

environment.swiftVersion:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx28.0

measurement.cacheStateProtocol: Warm and one-file-edit scenarios create one validated compatible cache seed outside timed commands. Every sample copies those exact bytes into a fresh state directory and resets from the same generated corpus.
measurement.coldStateDefinition: Each cold sample starts a new CLI process with either --no-repository-cache or an explicit absent cache path and a fresh derived-output directory; five unmeasured warmups precede measured samples, so filesystem pages may be resident.
measurement.crossVersionReportComparison: Canonical JSON excluding only engineVersion; raw report SHA-256 and engineVersion remain recorded.
measurement.design: paired-interleaved for comparable R1/R2 commands; independently reset cache state for every sequential R2-only sample
measurement.noiseFloorSource: Reference-only wall samples for paired R1/R2 scenarios; candidate calibration samples for R2-only proposed ceilings.

observabilityGaps: Repository analysis is included in end-to-end wall time and process RSS but has no dedicated AnalysisProfile phase.
The syntax-cache activity report proves zero cache network requests but the CLI has no embedding-provider or candidate-index operation telemetry.
Index size and candidate count are not applicable to measured similarity-disabled scenarios and unavailable for blocked index scenarios.

candidateIndex.reason: The optional SQVector product is outside this deterministic repository-cache benchmark slice.

embedding.reason: No embedding provider is initialized by the deterministic repository-rule and syntax-cache slice.

limits.provenance: Freeze a quiet-host window before sampling; the disk allowance is a fixed measurement-resolution floor, not a post-run adjustment.

releaseQualificationReason: Embedding and candidate-index operation telemetry, SQVector exact-index, ANN, and independently reviewed accuracy gates remain blocked or outside this deterministic cache slice.
